tools.name: submit_candidate
tools.description: Compile and retain the complete candidate; syntax feedback only, no hidden acceptance results.

tools.name: run_case
tools.description: Run a self-selected development input against current candidate and return the observable result.

arguments.source:
def compute(v):
    check(v["enabled"], "Disabled", 0)
    total = add(v["a"], v["b"], 1)
    check(total == v["expected"], "Mismatch", 2)
    result = add(total, 1, 3)
    premium_result = add(result, 2, 4)
    check(premium_result <= 1000, "PremiumLimit", 5)
    return premium_result
